#1 Big Island, Hawaii (Jan 5-12): Fly LAX-KOA nonstop. Pick up car, base in Kona. Sunset at Magic Sands or Kahalu'u beach, then poke for dinner.
#2 Oaxaca, Mexico (Jan 5-12): Fly LAX-OAX with one connection, arriving in the evening. Stay in Centro/Jalatlaco. Walk the zocalo and have mezcal nearby.
#3 La Paz + Todos Santos (Jan 5-12): Fly LAX-LAP nonstop (2.5h), pick up car. Stroll the Malecon at sunset and eat fish tacos.

#1 Big Island, Hawaii (Jan 5-12): Morning: Captain Cook Monument (Ka'awaloa) trail, about 3.8 mi round trip, with snorkeling at Kealakekua Bay. Afternoon: Pu'uhonua o Honaunau and a Kona coffee farm tour.
#2 Oaxaca, Mexico (Jan 5-12): Monte Alban in the morning (go early, it's hot and exposed). Afternoon: Museo de las Culturas at Santo Domingo and the Ethnobotanical Garden (guided visits only). Dinner: mole tasting menu.
#3 La Paz + Todos Santos (Jan 5-12): Full-day boat trip to Isla Espiritu Santo: sea-lion snorkel at Los Islotes, beach lunch. Book ahead.

#1 Big Island, Hawaii (Jan 5-12): North Kohala: Pololu Valley trail down to the black-sand beach, then Hawi town. Evening: manta-ray night snorkel off Kona (book ahead).
#2 Oaxaca, Mexico (Jan 5-12): Day trip east: El Tule tree, Teotitlan del Valle weavers, Mitla ruins, Hierve el Agua (swim in the mineral pools, short hike), a mezcal palenque on the way back.
#3 La Paz + Todos Santos (Jan 5-12): Balandra Bay: hike El Mirador trail and walk the shallows. Afternoon: La Paz Regional Museum of Anthropology. Whale-shark tour if in season (check the operator).

#1 Big Island, Hawaii (Jan 5-12): Mauna Kea: Onizuka visitor station for sunset and stargazing (bring warm layers; a tour van is needed for the summit). Easy morning at Hapuna Beach.
#2 Oaxaca, Mexico (Jan 5-12): Sierra Norte (Pueblos Mancomunados) guided hike, e.g. Cuajimoloyas to Latuvi via forest trails with lunch in a village. Optional overnight in a village cabin.
#3 La Paz + Todos Santos (Jan 5-12): Drive to Todos Santos (about 1h15). Walk the historic center and galleries. Sunset at Punta Lobos, where fishermen land pangas in the afternoon.

#1 Big Island, Hawaii (Jan 5-12): Drive to Volcano via Ka'u (Punalu'u black-sand beach, sea turtles). Check into Volcano village. Evening: Halema'uma'u overlook for glow if an eruption episode is happening (check the USGS HVO page that day).
#2 Oaxaca, Mexico (Jan 5-12): Slower day: Textile Museum, Mercado 20 de Noviembre and Benito Juarez market, cooking class with a market tour.
#3 La Paz + Todos Santos (Jan 5-12): Sierra de la Laguna foothills: Canon de la Zorra waterfall hike (short, near Santiago) or a longer guided canyon hike. Dinner at a farm-to-table restaurant near Todos Santos.

#1 Big Island, Hawaii (Jan 5-12): Hawai'i Volcanoes NP: Kilauea Iki trail (4 mi), Nahuku lava tube, Chain of Craters Road to the Holei Sea Arch. Volcano Art Center.
#2 Oaxaca, Mexico (Jan 5-12): San Jose del Pacifico or Ocotlan/San Martin Tilcajete (alebrije carvers) day trip, or a Hierve el Agua alternative. Rooftop dinner.
#3 La Paz + Todos Santos (Jan 5-12): Beach day: Las Palmas / Playa Cerritos (surf lesson option). Optional sunrise yoga or a whale-watching boat (humpbacks in season).
